pages.title: Build the starter...
pages.text:
You need a **Pulse Resonator**, an **Echo Shard**, and **Earth and Fire Resonance Totems**.\
1\. Place the Resonator.\
2\. Right-click it with the shard to install the reusable catalyst.\
3\. Place the two different totems within 8 blocks. The diagram shows a compact example.

pages.title: Continue
pages.text: 4\. Wait a second and inspect the generator. Stored Pulse should rise.

pages.title: Power budget
pages.text:
The starter generator makes a small amount of Pulse continuously. It does not mean every machine can run continuously. If a machine spends power faster than you make it, let a reserve build up or improve generation.\
Two identical totems count as one element. If generation stops, check the catalyst, different elements and pausing redstone.

pages.title: Continue
pages.text: Read the Spirit Codex before building larger totem layouts or a Conductor.
Example layout, not an exact quest requirement. Read the steps for materials and operation.
